sentences.text: VERSUS  THE STATE OF MAHARASHTRA Respon  IA No. 103380/2025 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT, IA No. 103375/2025 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. AND IA  No. 103381/2025 - PERMISSION TO FILE ADDITIONAL  DOCUMENTS/FACTS/ANNEXURES
This matter was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY KUMAR

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Aarif Ali, Adv.
 Mr. Shahid Nadeem, Adv.
 Mr. Mateen Shaikh, Adv.
 Mr. Mujahid Ahmad, Adv.
 Mr. Dhirendra Kumar Verma, Adv.
 Mr. Rakesh Ranjan, Adv.
 Ms. Saima Anjum, Adv.
 Mr. Chand Qureshi, AOR  For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel, the Court made the following  O R D E R Sahbaj Khan @ Ali Bhai Nagpada vs The State Of Maharashtra on 28 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89950460/
1

It is submitted that a similar issue, relating to the interpretation of Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, is pending consideration before this Court in several matters, including SLP (C) No.
605/2022, titled Sheikh Salim Sheikh Gafur & 16:56:13 IST Reason:
Anr. vs. The State of Maharashtra.
Issue notice, returnable in the week commencing 19.05.2025.
Notice shall be served by all modes, including dasti.

Till the next date of hearing, subject to his joining and cooperating with the investigation, the petitioner,
Sahbaj Khan @ Ali Bhai Nagpada, shall not be arrested in connection with First Information Report No. 65/2025 dated 21.02.2025 registered with Police Station  Dongri, District  Greater Mumbai City, Maharashtra, for the offence(s) punishable under Section 123, 223, 274, 275, 3(5) of the Bhartiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
